newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch consumer confidence rises in May.
newsitem.headline: Dutch consumer confidence rises in May.

text.p: The Dutch consumer confidence index rose to 16 in May from 13 in April, the Central Bureau of Statistics (CBS) said on Friday.
DUTCH CONSUMER CONFIDENCE May 97 April 97 May 96
Note - The index can vary between -100 and +100 points with zero as the neutral midpoint. A negative index value indicates a majority of the consumers polled by the CBS are pessimistic.
The total index is made up of two subindices which reflect consumers' feelings about the general economic climate and about their personal finances and spending plans:
The CBS said consumers remained optimistic as they see the economic climate as very positive and personal finances remained stable at a high level in May compared to April 1997.
